claim: In quantum mechanics, the spatial evolution of a wave packet due to a gravitational field depends on the ratio of gravitational to inertial mass, giving a quantum-mechanical version of the Universality of Free Fall.
falsifier: One can test by preparing wave packets with different mg/mi ratios and measuring their spatial evolution in a gravitational field.

exclusions: limited to the reported system and experimental conditions; transfer beyond unestablished

title: Ratio of gravitational–spatial evolution of mechanism
